write_door: journal.meta.set (MCP, cell: source cell_auto | cell_tool) · POST journal/{id}/meta (REST, a person: source owner_edit, locks the fields it changes) · document.summary.set (shortcut ⇒ about)
strict: unknown top-level key ⇒ entry_meta_invalid (400, fields[], hint, help_code); over a limit ⇒ the same; never silently cut on the strict door

about.note: what this is, in one or two sentences

caption.note: the words the sender typed with the file

locked.note: fields a person fixed; automatic passes skip them (EM-4)

rev.note: +1 on every write; expected_rev stale ⇒ entry_meta_conflict (409)

v1_1.doc_types: zalo-hub/contracts/DOC-TYPES-v1.json keys = BizCity_Journal_Entry_Meta::DOC_TYPES = BizCity_Journal_Doc_Meta::DOC_TYPES (18; outside the list ⇒ bad_value:doc.type on the strict door, `other` on a lax read); sensitive types: id_card · bank_statement

shape.date: YYYY-MM-DD (the date printed on the paper)
shape.totals: {amount int, currency ISO 4217, direction in|out|unknown, vat int}
shape.fields: ≤ 40 keys: scalar ≤ 300 chars, or a list ≤ 30 of scalars / flat objects
shape.uncertain: ≤ 20 field paths the code gate could not confirm

v1_1.errors: strict door, exact strings: unknown_field:doc.<k> · unknown_field:doc.totals.<k> · unknown_field:doc.book.<k> · unknown_field:read.<k> · bad_value:doc.type · bad_value:doc.date · bad_value:doc.totals.amount · bad_value:doc.totals.direction · bad_value:doc.book.state · bad_value:doc.book.family · bad_value:read.status · bad_value:read.method · too_long:doc.title · too_many:doc.parties · too_many:doc.dues · too_many:doc.fields · too_many:doc.book.refs · too_many:read.pages_failed · too_many:points · too_long:points
v1_1.merge: doc and read replace as a whole object, EXCEPT doc.book: journal.meta.set {meta:{doc:{book:{…}}}} alone changes only the book of the stored doc (offer made · row booked · owner declined); a full doc without book keeps the stored book
v1_1.find_text: + doc.title + the type label (score part title, weight 4) · points (about, 2) · party names + booked refs + doc.fields values (card, 1); a sensitive paper never gives party names or field values
v1_1.card: entry-card@1 section {id: book, label: 'Ghi sổ', text: 'Đã ghi sổ: CN-7, TC-45' (recorded) | 'Chờ ghi sổ' (offered / expired), refs[]}
v1_1.pipeline: journal-pipeline@1 read step + optional pages_read · pages_total · read_status; partial or still reading ⇒ label 'Đọc 10/12 trang'
v1_1.vault: twin-vault@1 frontmatter read{status, method, pages, pages_failed, doc{type, title, date, parties[], total '<amount> <currency>', dues['YYYY-MM-DD <amount>']}} — a sensitive paper keeps doc{type, title, date} (md-reading@1)
v1_1.access: brain-access@1 is_sensitive: + meta.doc.sensitive or a sensitive doc.type ⇒ a customer (guru:public) holds nothing on the row, whatever access.customer says

find_text: title · meta.title · about · summary · caption · OCR (≤ 4000) · keywords · topics · entities · people · visible card fields, joined with ' | ', then ' || ' + the folded copy (no diacritics, đ→d); ≤ 12000 chars; built by the site, never sent

find_v2.result: items sorted by score, each with why[] and score; SQL narrows ≤ 200 rows first

card_view: journal-kinds@1.6.0 kinds[*].card_view [{key, label, type: text|long_text|money|number|date|datetime|enum|person|list|link|count|items, enum?, currency_key?}] + hide[]; internal keys always hidden: as_of, seen, session, summary_by, summary_at, confidence, prev_card, mirror, items, messages_raw, version_family, version_parent

card.door: GET journal/{id}?view=card (REST, preview link signed only with file.get) · journal.get {view: card} (MCP, no link)

candidates.decide: POST journal/{id}/candidates/{cid} {decision: approve|reject} — approve books the target row (derived_from + origin.page_anchor, idempotency cand:<entry>:<cid>); a candidate is never a booked row by itself (SF-5)
